headline: On last trading day, Indian markets rebounded sharply, snapping an eight-week losing streak as Sensex and Nifty gained.

marketStatus.message: Market is closed today because it is a weekend. It will reopen on Monday, 12 October.

why: Indian shares surged on Friday, ending their longest weekly losing streak in 25 years.
Markets rebounded after tumbling earlier in the week due to oil price spikes and foreign investor outflows.
Finance Minister Nirmala Sitharaman met top executives of global investment funds to discuss investment opportunities in India.
SEBI Chairman announced upcoming guidelines on Consolidated Account Statements (CAS) within a week.
whatHappening: Sensex and Nifty snapped an 8-week losing streak during the last trading session.
Geopolitical developments and oil market shifts remain major triggers for market direction.
Global investment funds and top banks discussed India's growth outlook with Indian policymakers.
Equity markets are closed today for the weekend and will resume trading on Monday, 12 October.
summary: On the last trading day, Indian equity benchmark indices bounced back strongly, ending an eight-week losing streak. The gains followed days of steep declines triggered by global oil price surges and foreign fund selling. Indian markets are closed today for the weekend and will reopen on Monday, 12 October.
